vars.query: site:greenhouse.io/jobs ("Senior Developer" OR "Software Engineer") (C# OR .NET) "remote" -"security clearance"

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. Both 'issues' and 'suggestions' must be empty arrays. The query has clear role terms, technology terms, a valid ATS site filter, and a properly quoted exclusion.

vars.query: site:lever.co/jobs site:greenhouse.io/jobs ("Software Engineer" OR "Backend Engineer") (Python OR Django) "remote" (UTC+0 OR UTC+1 OR UTC+2)

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. Both 'issues' and 'suggestions' must be empty arrays. The query is well-structured with role terms, technology terms, timezone terms, and valid site filters.

vars.query: site:workable.com/jobs site:ashbyhq.com ("Senior Engineer" OR "Staff Engineer") (Golang OR Go) "fully remote" -"clearance" -"sponsorship not available"

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. Both 'issues' and 'suggestions' must be empty arrays. The query has no structural problems.

vars.query: site:greenhouse.io/jobs site:lever.co/jobs site:workable.com/jobs ("Data Engineer" OR "Data Platform Engineer") (Spark OR dbt OR Airflow) "remote" -"clearance"

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. Both 'issues' and 'suggestions' must be empty arrays. The query is well-formed.

description: Well-formed query — cloud engineering with timezone range

vars.query: site:ashbyhq.com site:greenhouse.io/jobs ("Cloud Engineer" OR "DevOps Engineer") (Terraform OR Kubernetes OR AWS) "remote" (UTC-5 OR UTC-6 OR UTC-7 OR UTC-8)

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. Both 'issues' and 'suggestions' must be empty arrays. The query is well-structured.

expectedIssues: Conflicting seniority terms make the query less focused.
expectedSuggestions: Choose one seniority level before reviewing results.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must mention conflicting or mixed seniority terms (intern, senior, entry level together). The 'suggestions' array must recommend narrowing to a single seniority level.

description: Overly broad role terms — no specificity
expectedIssues: The role terms are broad and may return noisy results.
expectedSuggestions: Add a specific role or technology term such as Backend Engineer, C#, or Azure.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must note that the query lacks specific role or technology terms. The 'suggestions' array must recommend adding a concrete role or tech term.

expectedIssues: Mixing remote, on-site, and hybrid terms is contradictory.
expectedSuggestions: Choose one work arrangement term to keep results focused.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must identify the contradiction between remote, on-site, and hybrid terms. The 'suggestions' array must recommend choosing a single work arrangement.

description: No explicit role term — technology only

vars.query: site:lever.co/jobs site:greenhouse.io/jobs (React OR Vue OR Angular) "senior" "remote"

expectedIssues: No explicit role term — the query relies only on technology names.
expectedSuggestions: Add a role term such as Frontend Developer or Software Engineer.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must note the absence of an explicit role title. The 'suggestions' array must recommend adding a role term.

vars.query: site:greenhouse.io/jobs ("Backend Engineer") (C# OR .NET OR C# OR dotnet) "senior" "remote"

expectedIssues: C# appears twice, creating a redundant term.
expectedSuggestions: Remove the duplicate C# to keep the query clean.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must identify the duplicate C# term. The 'suggestions' array must recommend removing the duplicate.

expectedIssues: The site filter is missing the /jobs path and may return non-job pages.
expectedSuggestions: Use site:greenhouse.io/jobs to restrict results to job listings.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must flag that 'site:greenhouse.io' is missing the '/jobs' path. The 'suggestions' array must recommend adding the path.

vars.query: site:greenhouse.io/jobs (Software Engineer OR Backend Developer) C# .NET remote -security clearance

expectedIssues: Multi-word phrases are not quoted and may not match correctly.
expectedSuggestions: Wrap multi-word phrases such as Software Engineer and security clearance in double quotes.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must flag that multi-word phrases like 'Software Engineer' and 'security clearance' lack quotes. The 'suggestions' array must recommend quoting them.

description: Excessive role and tech alternatives — query length risk

vars.query: site:greenhouse.io/jobs site:lever.co/jobs site:ashbyhq.com site:workable.com/jobs ("Software Engineer" OR "Backend Engineer" OR "Full Stack Developer" OR "Web Developer" OR "Application Developer" OR "Systems Engineer") (Java OR Python OR C# OR Go OR Ruby OR Scala OR Kotlin OR Swift OR JavaScript OR TypeScript OR Rust) "remote" "senior"

expectedIssues: Too many role and technology alternatives may exceed Google query length limits or return overly broad results.
expectedSuggestions: Narrow to 2-3 role terms and 3-4 technology terms most relevant to the target role.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must flag excessive query length or too many alternatives. The 'suggestions' array must recommend narrowing the role and technology terms.

description: No site filter — open web search

vars.query: ("Senior Software Engineer" OR "Principal Engineer") (Rust OR C++) "fully remote" -"relocation required"

expectedIssues: No site: filter — this searches the open web rather than ATS career portals.
expectedSuggestions: Add site: filters such as site:greenhouse.io/jobs or site:lever.co/jobs to target ATS platforms.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must flag the absence of any site: filter. The 'suggestions' array must recommend adding ATS site filters.

vars.query: site:greenhouse.io/jobs ("Software Engineer") (Python OR FastAPI) -"visa sponsorship required" "sponsorship available"

expectedIssues: Visa terms are contradictory — excluding visa sponsorship required while including sponsorship available.
expectedSuggestions: Keep only the exclusion if you do not need sponsorship, or only the inclusion if you do.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must identify the contradiction between the visa exclusion and the positive visa term. The 'suggestions' array must recommend keeping only one.

description: Role term in exclusions — suppresses relevant listings
expectedIssues: Backend Engineer appears as an excluded term and will suppress listings that use that title.
expectedSuggestions: Move role terms to the main query instead of the exclusions.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must flag that a job role title (Backend Engineer) is being excluded. The 'suggestions' array must recommend moving it to the main query.

expectedIssues: Multiple remote synonyms are redundant — any one is sufficient.
expectedSuggestions: Keep one or two remote terms and remove the rest to reduce query noise.

assert.value: Response must be valid JSON. The 'issues' array must note the redundancy of listing many remote synonyms. The 'suggestions' array must recommend reducing to one or two.
